name: Atascocita Commons
summary: Atascocita Commons is a Kimco Realty-managed community shopping center located on FM 1960 in Humble, Texas, serving the growing Atascocita area. With a 4.4-star rating from nearly 2,000 reviews, it provides convenient access to retail, dining, and services for northeast Houston families.
demographics: Atascocita Commons serves the growing suburban communities of Humble and Atascocita in northeast Houston, attracting primarily middle-income families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000. The trade area consists largely of young families and professionals aged 25-54 with children, drawn to the area's affordable housing and highly-rated schools. Shoppers in this market typically seek convenient, one-stop shopping experiences for everyday needs including groceries, dining, and essential services, with a preference for value-oriented national retailers and family-friendly amenities.
description: Atascocita Commons is a community shopping center strategically located on Farm to Market 1960 Road East in Humble, Texas, serving the thriving Atascocita and northeast Houston communities. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, this property provides essential retail and dining options for the rapidly growing suburban population. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, offering convenient access to a diverse mix of tenants that cater to the everyday needs of local families and professionals. With a strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 2,000 Google reviews, Atascocita Commons has established itself as a reliable neighborhood destination for shopping, dining, and services. Its location along the busy FM 1960 corridor ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for residents throughout the greater Humble area, making it an integral part of the community's retail landscape.
